SPEED · Design Engineering

This browser can't run the tool

SPEED needs the File System Access API to create project folders and copy drawing files. Only Chromium-based browsers implement it.

Use Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome. Firefox and Safari do not support it, and there is no workaround.

If you are already in Edge or Chrome and see this message, the API may be blocked by company policy, or the page may be served from a location the browser does not treat as secure.


  






  

    


  
  

    

    

    

      
      
      
    


    
      

      
Folders

      

        

        

          
          
          
        

        

          
          
          

            Browsers never reveal a folder's real path for privacy reasons, so the
            tool cannot work it out. Paste it once from Explorer's address bar and
            Copy path on each project will give you a full,
            pasteable path. Saved on this machine only.
          

        


        

          The SPEED folder must contain Project Template.
          Projects are created in a Projects subfolder.
          The reports folder is where
          sf_report_extractor.py writes its CSVs — leave it unset to
          look inside the SPEED folder.
        


        

          After restarting the computer the browser remembers which
          folder you chose but not the permission to read it, and it will only
          re-grant that on a click. Press Reconnect when the bar
          asks — you do not have to find the folder again. Chrome can stop asking
          entirely if you choose Allow on every visit in its permission
          prompt.

Voltage drop

        


        

          
            Conductor sizing convention — read this before stamping
          
          

            Conductors are sized to
            max(1.25 × Ibranch, Ibranch ÷ tempFactor ÷ fillFactor),
            taken from IPlot-Tool. This reads NEC 690.8(B) as two independent
            requirements where the larger governs.
            


            Permit Calc.xlsx computes it differently —
            (1.25 × I) ÷ tempFactor ÷ fillFactor — applying derating
            on top of the 125% uplift. That is more conservative and can call for
            a larger conductor. The two agree at low currents and diverge as
            derating becomes severe. Confirm which convention your EOR signs off
            on before this output goes onto a stamped drawing.

iPermit package

        

          


          

            

              
              
            

            

              
            

          

          

          


          

            


            

              
              
            

            


            

              

                

                  
                  Equipment
                  Model matched
                  PDF in Spec Sheets folder
                  Order
                

                
              

            


            


            


            

              
            

            


            

              The CAD plot goes first, then the ticked sheets in the order shown.
              The result is written to the project's Deliverables
              folder as <Project Number> - <CUSTOMER> - iPermit Package.pdf.
              


              The offering decides what the package must contain.
              One sheet each, and the build is refused while a required one is
              missing or ticked twice — a reviewer seeing two different modules
              cannot tell which is installed. Optional sheets are noted only.
              


              Encrypted datasheets cannot be merged. Many
              manufacturer PDFs carry permissions-only protection. The build is
              refused rather than quietly leaving a sheet out — open the file,
              Save As over itself to drop the protection, then retry.

          Save to folder writes this table to
          <SPEED folder>/Reference Data/<TABLE>.json. That file is
          loaded on every start and overrides the copy built into
          SPEED.html — so edits survive without touching GitHub.
          


          Because the JSON lives in your SPEED folder, two designers
          pointing at two different folders will drift apart. Keep one
          shared SPEED folder if the whole team must calculate from the same
          data. Each tab shows whether it is running built-in or folder data.
        

        

          
            Why some tables must stay sorted
          
          

            RT_AMPACITY, RT_EGC and
            RT_BREAKERS are searched with .find(), which
            returns the first row meeting the requirement. If a row is
            inserted out of order the lookup silently returns the wrong conductor
            or breaker — no error, just an incorrect drawing. Validate checks the
            ordering and blocks export if it is broken.
            


            Duplicate keys are blocked for the same reason: the second row would
            be unreachable.
